# Dayloop v0.16.0-rc1 — P3R test release

Install **dayloop-v0.16.0-rc1-candidate.apk** on Android 8.0 or newer.
This is the candidate app (`com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`), signed
with the CI Android debug key. It installs alongside the stable app and has its
own profiles, settings and progress. Existing stable-app data is not transferred
automatically; use Settings → Export/Import backup to copy it when supported by
your installed version. Keep your existing app and saves.

## Included

- P3R interface updates across Today, calendar, day details, Requests, Social Links,
  achievements and Settings, including revised headers and side-by-side task controls.
- Swipeable months, full-moon markers and centered Perfect Day artwork with shadows.
- Progress backup export/import.
- All **101 Elizabeth request solutions**, including the ultimate-adversary preparation
  and phase strategy; all 14 timed requests and 24 exact automatic reporting anchors.
- Tartarus preparation, rescue and reporting guidance. P3R content version **14**.
- Existing P5R and Metaphor pack content preserved.

## Testing

Select Persona 3 Reload, then check the daily layout, month swipes and expanded
Request #101 instructions. Try task completion/reversal and a backup round trip.
This is a testing milestone; the remaining P3R roadmap is still active.

The release workflow runs the build, JVM tests, all three pack validations and APK
signature verification before publishing. The source implementation also passed
both Android review jobs before release preparation.

If an older candidate install has a different signing key, Android may reject an
in-place update. Export that candidate's progress before replacing it. Do not
uninstall an app containing progress you have not backed up.
